issue_context.title: IsLocalEphemeralVolume function misses secret volume type
issue_context.body:
In the function IsLocalEphemeralVolume to check whether volume is using ephemeral storage or not, it misses "secret" volume type. 
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/volume/util/util.go#L544
comments: Secrets are mounted as tmpfs, so I think they are not local ephemeral "volumes".
close this since it is not an issue
